change_events.description: Reduced GPU memory reservation from 90% to 70% across cluster gpu-cluster-01 to free headroom for burst workloads.
Rolled out inference-api v3.4.1 with updated batching logic. Canary 10% → 100% over 2 hours.
Scheduled BGP route refresh on spine switches SW-03 and SW-04. Expected 30-second convergence window.
Updated cost-attribution tagging policy to include project-level breakdown. No expected service impact.
Rolled back GPU scheduler config (CHG-1001) after observing 15% utilization drop on gpu-node-07. Reverted memory reservation to 90%.
Increased request timeout from 30s to 60s on inference-api to accommodate large-batch requests.

decisions.summary: Team decided to reduce GPU memory reservation to allow burst headroom. Risk accepted: possible utilization dip during transition. Revisit in 1 week.
action_items: priya.sharma: monitor inference-api p99 latency post-change

decisions.summary: Agreed to move from fixed-size to dynamic batching in inference-api v3.4.1 to improve GPU utilization and reduce tail latency. Feature flag for gradual rollout.
action_items: ml-arch: finalize dynamic batching config by end of sprint
sre-lead: add latency SLO alerts before full rollout

decisions.summary: CAB approved BGP route refresh during low-traffic window (22:00–23:00 UTC). Accepted 30-second convergence impact. Runbook prepared and on-call notified.
action_items: sre-lead: monitor network latency alerts during window

decisions.summary: Approved new project-level cost tagging policy. All teams must update resource tags by 2025-04-30. Non-compliant resources will be flagged in weekly FinOps report.
action_items: platform-pm: communicate deadline to all team leads

runbooks.title: GPU Utilization Drop Investigation
steps: 1. Check recent change events for gpu-scheduler and gpu-cluster-01 (last 48h).
2. Query telemetry: SELECT ts, node, utilization_pct FROM telemetry_gpu WHERE ts > NOW()-48h ORDER BY ts.
3. Identify nodes with utilization_pct < 30% for more than 10 minutes.
4. Check if a config change (e.g., memory reservation) is correlated with the drop timestamp.
5. If correlated: open rollback change request via CHG process. Owner: alex.morgan@contoso.com.
6. If not correlated: check for job queue drain (no workloads scheduled) or hardware fault.
7. Escalate to platform-infra-oncall if unresolved within 30 minutes.
runbooks.severity_threshold: P2 if > 2 nodes affected; P1 if entire cluster

runbooks.title: Inference API Latency Spike
steps: 1. Check p99 latency trend: SELECT ts, p99_ms FROM telemetry_net WHERE service='inference-api' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 60.
2. Correlate with recent deployments to inference-api (last 24h change events).
3. Check batch size configuration — large batches increase tail latency.
4. If a deployment is correlated: assess rollback vs. config fix (timeout increase).
5. If no recent deployment: check GPU utilization — inference latency tracks GPU saturation.
6. Notify ml-platform-oncall if p99 > 2x baseline for > 5 minutes.
7. If SLO breach confirmed: trigger PagerDuty PD-INFERENCE-API.
runbooks.severity_threshold: P2 if p99 > 1000ms; P1 if p99 > 5000ms

runbooks.title: Network Latency / Packet Loss Incident
steps: 1. Identify affected spine/leaf switches from alert metadata.
2. Check for scheduled maintenance windows (change events, type=maintenance).
3. If within maintenance window: monitor until window closes; no action unless exceeds window.
4. If outside maintenance window: SSH to affected switch and run 'show bgp summary'.
5. Check for BGP session flaps in the last 60 minutes.
6. If flap detected: collect logs and escalate to network-ops-oncall.
7. Escalation path: james.liu@contoso.com → network-arch@contoso.com → NOC.
runbooks.severity_threshold: P2 if packet loss > 0.1%; P1 if packet loss > 1% or full link down

runbooks.title: Cost Attribution Anomaly
steps: 1. Check cost trend: SELECT ts, total_cost_usd, service FROM telemetry_cost ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 30.
2. Identify services with > 20% week-over-week cost increase.
3. Cross-reference with change events — new deployments often drive cost spikes.
4. Check tagging compliance — untagged resources may appear as cost spikes in 'unknown' bucket.
5. Engage finops-lead@contoso.com for budget impact assessment.
6. If unauthorized spend: file FinOps ticket and notify platform-pm.
runbooks.severity_threshold: Low (informational); escalate if > $10k unexpected spend in 24h
